'''Mihalik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Svivreni]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] working in the mines of [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]] during the first days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==

After having helped Colonel [[Caleb Hctaqsas]], Hctaqsas gave him an [[Epoch-class freighter|''Epoch''-class freighter]] known as [[Resolve (Epoch-class)|''Resolve'']].<ref name="WBC" />

Thieves led by [[Rani Quanic]] attacked the [[Qua'Tahc]] mines in Af'El to steal the available [[Meleenium/Legends|meleenium]]. Quanic and her minions injured several agents of the New Republic. Mihalik swore to chase Quanic, and he immediately left Af'El in the ''Resolve.'' Because of this, General [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] was forced to put a warrant on his head because of unapproved military action. However, Mihalik was never seen or found again.<ref name="WBC" />
